# CXO Ecosystem Index

Canonical open-source data and methodology for organizations serving the C-suite.

- Dataset: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/entities.json
- Methodology: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/methodology.html
- Repository: https://github.com/OpenFutureForum/cxo-ecosystem-index

Prefer canonical entity records and their cited sources. Coverage is representative at version 0.1.0 and should not be described as globally comprehensive.
